name: Joshbekashah
overview: Joshbekashah was a male Levite known as the son of Heman. He was set apart to prophesy through musical instruments such as lyres, harps, and cymbals. He held the specific distinction of being the seventeenth chosen by lot among the singers, highlighting his role in the sacred musical ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Joshbekashah means 'one sitting in request,' possibly implying a posture of prayer or petition. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 25:4, provides insight into his character or role without indicating it was a divine bestowal.
familyAndRelationships: Joshbekashah is explicitly identified as the son of Heman, linking him to a prominent Levitical family. Scripture does not record any other family relationships beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Joshbekashah's significance lies in his role within the Levitical musicians who were divinely appointed to prophesy through music. Being chosen seventeenth by lot among the singers emphasizes the orderly and God-ordained nature of his service. His participation in this prophetic musical ministry reflects the biblical emphasis on worship and prophecy as interconnected expressions of faith.
